raw.descriptionHtml:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

Responsibilities

  • Develop performant, testable, scalable, and robust applications and services.

  • Develop components that interoperate with Linux internals.

  • Participate in planning and design sessions for projects, in collaboration with Product, Program Management, UX, and other stakeholders.

  • Translate software requirements into detailed development tasks.

  • Execute development tasks with an emphasis on code quality, handling of security vulnerabilities, and unit testing.

  • Review code changes made by other engineers on your team.

  • Participate in defining coding standards and guidelines to ensure a high quality of code.

  • Collaborate with engineers across the organization to resolve issues when necessary.

  • Participate in writing clear and detailed technical design documents.

  • Research and leverage open-source technologies where appropriate.

  • Contribute innovative ideas for technical improvements and business opportunities.

  • Stay up-to-date with and incorporate industry trends and best practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or similar.

  • 7+ years of work experience.

  • 5+ years of work experience using Golang.

  • Experience developing REST, gRPC, GraphQL, and WebSocket APIs in Golang.

  • Experience working with VMs, Docker, and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with Linux kernel management, networking, and boot process.

  • Experience with OAuth2 and RBAC.

  • Experience working with message brokers including Kafka and MQTT.

  • Experience using relational and time series databases including MySQL and InfluxDB.

  • Experience using cloud services with AWS, GCP, and Azure.

  • Experience working with CI/CD frameworks.

  • Fluent in Git and source control management concepts.

  • Very organized, with great attention to detail.

  • Creative, and open to different ideas from other engineers.

  • Very responsive and willing to help other engineers in need.

  • Likes to work in a collaborative, fast-paced, and results-driven environment.

  • Passionate about software engineering and interested in IIoT.

Salary is commensurate on experience, background, location and qualifications. Base salary range for this position is $120,000 to $150,000 CAD.

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

Description

  • As a Software Engineer - Golang Developer specializing in C++ and Golang, you will play a pivotal role in developing southbound connectors for communication with PLCs and industrial control systems, enabling seamless data exchange between our Litmus Edge Products and a diverse range of IIoT devices, industrial protocols, and operational technology systems.

  • Your primary responsibility will be to design, implement, and maintain robust connectors that ensure the reliability, security, and efficiency of communication between our software and the operational technology (OT) layer. Your work will be essential in enabling our products to scale and adapt to ever-evolving industrial environments.

What you will do:

  1. Develop C++ and Golang-based southbound connectors that communicate directly with PLCs and industrial control systems using protocols such as OPC-UA, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, and DNP3.

  1. Implement support for IIoT protocols such as MQTT, CoAP, and SOAP, enabling effective communication with industrial devices and sensors.

  1. Build connectors for streaming protocols such as WebSockets and HTTP/2, enabling real-time data streaming and communication with external systems.

  1. Implement robust error handling and fault-tolerance mechanisms to ensure connectors are resilient to failures in OT environments, delivering a seamless user experience.

  1. Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including product managers, OT/controls engineers, and other developers — to understand requirements and deliver high-quality integration solutions.

  1. Conduct thorough testing, including unit tests, integration tests, and hardware-in-the-loop tests, to validate the functionality and performance of southbound connectors.

  1. Optimize code and apply best practices to enhance connector performance, latency, and scalability.

  1. Provide clear and comprehensive technical documentation for all connectors and APIs, enabling seamless adoption by other team members and customers.

  1. Monitor connector performance, track metrics, and implement logging practices to troubleshoot and resolve issues efficiently.

  1. Stay current with advancements in the C++, Golang, and industrial automation ecosystems, continuously developing your skills and knowledge.

  1. Contribute to the development of our open-source projects, sharing expertise with the wider developer community.

What you will bring:

  1. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

  1. Proven experience as a Software Engineer with a minimum of 5+ years of relevant work experience.

  1. Strong proficiency in C++ is required, and experience with Golang is a nice-to-have.

  1. Demonstrated experience developing southbound connectors for PLCs and industrial control systems, with hands-on knowledge of industrial protocols such as OPC-UA, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, or PROFINET.

  1. Deep understanding of networking concepts, real-time communication, and industrial automation environments.

  1. Experience implementing support for IIoT protocols is highly desirable.

  1. Solid working knowledge of data serialization, error handling, and security principles in integration projects — 5+ years of experience preferred.

  1. 5+ years of experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and collaborative development practices.

  1. Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze complex integration challenges in OT environments.

  1. Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams including engineers from both software and industrial automation backgrounds.

If you are a motivated, innovative, and results-oriented engineer with a passion for bridging the gap between industrial control systems and modern edge computing infrastructure, we encourage you to apply. Join our dynamic team and play a crucial role in shaping the future of Litmus Automation as a leading player in the Industrial Internet of Things space..

This is an in Office only position in Pune. Remote work is not allowed for the Pune office.

Litmus Automation is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace environment. We celebrate individuality and believe that diverse perspectives lead to innovation.

raw.descriptionHtml:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

Description

  • As a Senior Software Engineer specializing in C++ and Golang, you will play a pivotal role in developing southbound connectors for communication with PLCs and industrial control systems, enabling seamless data exchange between our Litmus Edge Products and a diverse range of IIoT devices, industrial protocols, and operational technology systems.

  • Your primary responsibility will be to design, implement, and maintain robust connectors that ensure the reliability, security, and efficiency of communication between our software and the operational technology (OT) layer. Your work will be essential in enabling our products to scale and adapt to ever-evolving industrial environments.

 

What you will do:

  1. Develop C++ and Golang-based southbound connectors that communicate directly with PLCs and industrial control systems using protocols such as OPC-UA, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, and DNP3.

  1. Implement support for IIoT protocols such as MQTT, CoAP, and SOAP, enabling effective communication with industrial devices and sensors.

  1. Build connectors for streaming protocols such as WebSockets and HTTP/2, enabling real-time data streaming and communication with external systems.

  1. Implement robust error handling and fault-tolerance mechanisms to ensure connectors are resilient to failures in OT environments, delivering a seamless user experience.

  1. Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including product managers, OT/controls engineers, and other developers — to understand requirements and deliver high-quality integration solutions.

  1. Conduct thorough testing, including unit tests, integration tests, and hardware-in-the-loop tests, to validate the functionality and performance of southbound connectors.

  1. Optimize code and apply best practices to enhance connector performance, latency, and scalability.

  1. Provide clear and comprehensive technical documentation for all connectors and APIs, enabling seamless adoption by other team members and customers.

  1. Monitor connector performance, track metrics, and implement logging practices to troubleshoot and resolve issues efficiently.

  1. Stay current with advancements in the C++, Golang, and industrial automation ecosystems, continuously developing your skills and knowledge.

  1. Contribute to the development of our open-source projects, sharing expertise with the wider developer community.

 

What you will bring:

  1. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

  1. Proven experience as a Software Engineer with a minimum of 5+ years of relevant work experience.

  1. Strong proficiency in Golang

  1. Demonstrated experience developing southbound connectors for PLCs and industrial control systems, with hands-on knowledge of industrial protocols such as OPC-UA, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, or PROFINET.

  1. Deep understanding of networking concepts, real-time communication, and industrial automation environments.

  1. Experience implementing support for IIoT protocols is highly desirable.

  1. Solid working knowledge of data serialization, error handling, and security principles in integration projects — 5+ years of experience preferred.

  1. 5+ years of experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and collaborative development practices.

  1. Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze complex integration challenges in OT environments.

  1. Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams including engineers from both software and industrial automation backgrounds.

 

If you are a motivated, innovative, and results-oriented engineer with a passion for bridging the gap between industrial control systems and modern edge computing infrastructure, we encourage you to apply. Join our dynamic team and play a crucial role in shaping the future of Litmus Automation as a leading player in the Industrial Internet of Things space..

This position is hybrid in Toronto and Santa Clara. Full remote is possible for the right candidate.

Litmus Automation is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace environment. We celebrate individuality and believe that diverse perspectives lead to innovation.

You will inherit a capable, distributed team and a meaningful technical foundation: self-hosted GitLab for CI/CD, multi-cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP, Kubernetes (EKS) workloads, and an on-premises VMware estate. Technical Leadership & Team

 - Serve as the primary technical decision-maker for the DevOps function — architecture, tooling choices, prioritization, and delivery standards.

 - Represent the DevOps function at the leadership level, including communicating roadmap, risks, and platform health to the Head of Technology and broader Technology leadership.



CI/CD Platform (GitLab)

   - Pipeline security integrations (SAST, container scanning, IaC analysis)

• Exposure to cloud data platforms — Databricks, Snowflake, InfluxDB — or cloud marketplaces (Azure, AWS, GCP)

• Experience with manufacturing execution or operations platforms such as Tulip

WHO IS LITMUS

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.




WHY JOIN LITMUS





BUILD THE INFRASTRUCTURE THAT MAKES INDUSTRIAL AI POSSIBLE

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.





WORK ON PROBLEMS WHERE SOFTWARE MEETS THE REAL WORLD

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.





HAVE REAL IMPACT, FAST

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.





JOIN A HIGH-PERFORMANCE TEAM

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.




OUR CULTURE

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly skilled and passionate Senior Yocto & Linux Software Engineer to join our engineering team in Pune, India. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and securing Litmus Edge, our flagship industrial edge computing platform built using the Yocto Project. You will play a key role in embedded Linux development, system optimization, secure software delivery, OTA updates, and hardware-software integration, helping drive the next generation of Industrial IoT and Industry 4.0 solutions.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design, develop, and maintain embedded Linux distributions using the Yocto Project for the Litmus Edge platform.

 - Create, extend, and manage Yocto packages while ensuring platform stability and maintainability.

 - Develop and support secure validation processes to enhance system integrity and resilience.

 - Build and maintain Over-the-Air (OTA) update mechanisms for reliable software deployment and upgrades.

 - Configure, integrate, and deploy software on ARM-based hardware platforms using BSPs.

 - Leverage Docker and Kubernetes (Kubernetes/K8s) to deploy and manage containerized edge applications.

 - Collaborate with hardware, platform, and application teams to troubleshoot and resolve complex integration challenges.

 - Analyze, debug, and optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.

 - Contribute to software development best practices, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

 - Stay current with advancements in embedded Linux, Yocto, containerization technologies, and edge computing.

 - Utilize AI-powered tools and technologies to improve engineering productivity and accelerate delivery outcomes.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING


MUST HAVE

 - 5+ years of experience in Linux software engineering with a strong focus on embedded systems.

 - Deep hands-on expertise with the Yocto Project, including custom image creation, package management, and build system customization.

 - Strong experience with embedded Linux development, kernel configuration, debugging, and system integration.

 - Experience working with ARM-based platforms and Board Support Packages (BSPs).

 - Hands-on knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes in production or edge computing environments.

 - Experience designing or maintaining OTA update frameworks and deployment systems.

 - Strong programming skills in C/C++ and scripting languages such as Python and Bash.

 - Proficiency with Git and CI/CD tools and workflows.

 - Awareness of Generative AI and AI Agents, with the ability to leverage AI tools to improve engineering efficiency and deliverables.

 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building and maintaining RHEL packages (RPM).

 - Knowledge of secure boot, platform validation, and security-focused software development practices.

 - Experience working in Industrial IoT, Industry 4.0, or edge computing environments.

 - Familiarity with Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS).

 - Understanding of networking protocols, cybersecurity, and device security.

 - Contributions to open-source projects or active participation in the open-source community.

 - Practical experience implementing AI-driven solutions or automation within engineering projects.

  • Background in manufacturing software or infrastructure is an asset

We’re hiring a Sales Engineer to play a central role in the Litmus sales cycle. You’ll partner closely with Account Executives to understand customer challenges in OT/IT integration and Industry 4.0, then demonstrate how the Litmus platform delivers measurable value. You bring hands-on knowledge of the factory floor — discrete and batch production, industrial software ecosystems, and the realities of connecting OT to IT.

What You’ll Do

• Lead technical discovery with prospects — uncovering business and technical requirements to shape solution presentations

• Deliver tailored product demos and solution presentations that address customer-specific use cases

• Deploy and support small pilots and proof-of-concept projects

• Work alongside Account Executives throughout the sales cycle to provide technical depth and credibility

• Respond to RFIs and RFPs with accurate, compelling technical content

• Relay market and customer feedback to Product Management — gaps, feature requests, and competitive insights

What You’ll Bring

Must Have

• 3–5 years of technical experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, OT/IT, or a related field

• Experience in a pre-sales, sales engineering, or customer-facing technical role

• Ability to engage credibly with both OT engineers and business/IT stakeholders

• Comfort with scripting (Python or JavaScript) and working with APIs

Nice to Have

• Hands-on familiarity with industrial software ecosystems — SCADA, MES/MOM, Historians, or similar

• Familiarity with cloud infrastructure — Azure, AWS, or GCP — in an industrial context

• Knowledge of databases (SQL or NoSQL) and container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)

• Industry exposure in Automotive, Food & Beverage, Life Sciences, or Chemical manufacturing

• BS/MS in Electrical, Industrial, or Computer Engineering (or equivalent experience)

raw.descriptionHtml:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

The Role

This is not a typical BDR seat. As a Strategic BDR at Litmus, you will own the top of the funnel for a defined set of target accounts — building pipeline through thoughtful, insight-led outreach rather than spray-and-pray volume. You will be expected to understand your prospects' operational challenges deeply, connect those challenges to the Litmus platform, and create genuine buying interest at the executive and operational level.

You'll work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and Sales Leadership to execute account-based strategies against our Ideal Customer Profile — large manufacturers undergoing digital transformation. This role is for someone who is already good at the fundamentals and wants to grow into a more strategic, account-centric motion.

Key Responsibilities

• Account-Based Prospecting: Own a named target account list; research organizational structure, technology stack, and operational priorities to build tailored entry strategies.

• Strategic Outreach: Execute high-quality, multi-channel sequences (email, phone, LinkedIn, events) that lead with insight and industry relevance — not generic templates.

• Executive Engagement: Identify and engage plant managers, VP Operations, Head of Manufacturing IT, and other economic buyers; understand their digital transformation priorities and connect them to Litmus's value proposition.

• Pipeline Creation: Consistently generate qualified opportunities that meet the bar: right persona, right problem, right timeline. Quality over volume.

• AE Partnership: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with your paired AE — align on account strategy, co-develop messaging, and ensure seamless handoffs that don't lose momentum.

• Market Intelligence: Stay current on manufacturing trends (IIoT, smart factory, AI at the edge, OEE) to sharpen your outreach and inform the GTM team's positioning.

• CRM Discipline: Keep Salesforce clean and current — activity logs, contact data, opportunity stages. Your pipeline is your professional reputation.

What We're Looking For

• Experience: 2–5 years in B2B sales or business development, ideally in industrial technology, manufacturing software, IoT, or adjacent enterprise SaaS.

• Track Record: Consistent attainment of pipeline and meeting targets; examples of breaking into new accounts or landing cold outreach with senior stakeholders.

• Strategic Mindset: You research before you reach out. You can connect operational pain to platform value without reciting a script.

• Communication: Strong written and verbal skills — capable of writing a cold email a VP of Operations actually replies to.

• Resilience: You're comfortable with long sales cycles, complex buying committees, and the reality that most great deals start with a 'not right now.'

• Tech Fluency: Proficient in Salesforce and modern sales tools (Outreach, Salesloft, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).

Preferred Qualifications

• Background in manufacturing, industrial automation, edge computing, or IIoT.

• Experience with account-based sales motions and named account strategies.

• Familiarity with sales methodologies such as Challenger, SPIN, or Sandler.

• Exposure to enterprise sales cycles involving IT, OT, and operational stakeholders.

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary with uncapped commission potential.

• Fast-track career growth — strong BDRs at Litmus move into AE or senior GTM roles.

• Access to industry training, certifications, and mentorship from experienced operators.

• Remote and hybrid flexibility depending on location.

• The chance to be part of something genuinely important — the infrastructure layer that makes industrial AI real.

  • Lead and mentor the Pune engineering and QA teams.

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Java and Go.

  • Drive architecture decisions, code quality, security, and engineering best practices.

  • Collaborate with global engineering and product teams to deliver product roadmap initiatives.

  • Translate product requirements into scalable technical solutions.

  • Own engineering quality, testing strategy, and CI/CD standards.

  • Build and grow the engineering team through hiring, coaching, and technical mentorship.

  • Strong expertise in Java (Spring Boot) and good working knowledge of Go.

  • Experience building distributed systems and microservices.

  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, messaging systems, databases, and system design.

  • Experience leading engineering teams and mentoring developers.

  • Excellent communication skills and experience working with globally distributed teams.

  • Experience using AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude.

  • Experience with Industrial IoT, edge computing, or manufacturing software.

  • Knowledge of MQTT, OPC-UA, Modbus, Kafka, or RabbitMQ.

  • Experience with AI/ML deployment at the edge.

  • Familiarity with Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and observability platforms.

  • Experience building Global Capability Centers or leading distributed engineering teams.

Why Join Litmus?

  • Build next-generation Industrial AI and Edge Computing products.

  • Work on large-scale distributed systems used by global manufacturers.

  • Collaborate with highly experienced global engineering teams.

  • Lead the growth of a strategic engineering team in Pune.

  • Influence architecture, product direction, and engineering culture from day one.

Litmus is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace where innovation and collaboration thrive.

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

Customer Success Account Manager

About the Role

The Customer Success Account Manager is a key customer-facing role within the Litmus Customer Success team, responsible for customer retention, renewals, adoption, and value realization. You’ll build strong customer relationships, establish success plans and engagement cadences, lead onboarding and renewal activities, and monitor account health to ensure customers are achieving value from Litmus.

You’ll also act as a customer advocate across Litmus, coordinating with internal teams to ensure issues, incidents, feature requests, and bug fixes are appropriately prioritized and communicated.

Reporting to the Vice President of Customer Success, you’ll work closely with Sales Account Executives, Expansion Leads, Project Managers, Application Engineers, Presales Engineers, Support, Finance, the Litmus Partner team, and other Customer Success team members. You’ll also support enterprise expansion and services opportunities where appropriate, ensuring clear handoffs, accurate account information, and strong cross-functional coordination.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the overall relationship for assigned customers and partners, building strong relationships with key stakeholders through regular customer engagement, success planning, and proactive touchpoints to drive adoption, value realization, retention, and customer loyalty.

  • Lead post-sale customer onboarding activities, including license provisioning and maintenance, and ensure a smooth transition from Sales to Customer Success.

  • Act as the primary escalation point for customer tickets, incidents, feature requests, and bug fixes, coordinating internally on priorities and communicating progress and resolution to customers.

  • Manage customer health assessments, adoption data, CSAT/NPS feedback, account health indicators, and related actions for assigned accounts.

  • Manage Salesforce renewal opportunities and oversee license, subscription, and support renewal processes, including AMC terms and conditions.

  • Coordinate billing management and payment follow-up with Accounts Receivable and Finance for assigned customer accounts.

  • Identify services, upsell, and project or consulting expansion opportunities within assigned accounts.

  • Provide input into account strategy and account mapping, maintain site and project account intelligence, and keep Account Executives and cross-functional stakeholders informed of customer context and priorities.

  • Develop and execute account plans, support technical account planning, and document customer use cases to support internal visibility and future sales opportunities.

  • Oversee customer support contract SLA adherence and ensure customers are informed of new product releases and guided toward long-term release versions of Litmus software.

  • Drive customer advocacy by identifying and developing opportunities for references, referrals, case studies, logo usage, and other advocacy activities.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Customer Success processes, renewal playbooks, onboarding practices, account management systems, and cross-functional ways of working.

What You’ll Bring

Must Have

  • 7+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, managing relationships with senior customer stakeholders and operational teams.

  • 2+ years of experience working with manufacturing customers or within the manufacturing industry, ideally in Customer Success, Account Management, or a technology-related role.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to manage customer expectations, communicate clearly, and coordinate internal stakeholders.

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage renewals, escalations, account plans, and multiple customer priorities simultaneously.

  • Strong negotiation and commercial skills, with the ability to identify and support upsell, cross-sell, and services expansion opportunities.

  • Ability to work effectively cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Professional Services, Engineering, Project Management, Presales, Partners, and Finance.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing customer-facing projects, services engagements, onboarding, or implementation activities.

  • Experience working with manufacturing software, industrial technology, automation, IoT/IIoT, or related technologies.

  • A self-starter who enjoys solving problems, improving processes, and advocating for customer outcomes.

  • Experience working in Salesforce or a similar CRM to manage renewals, opportunities, account information, and customer activity.

  • Comfortable adapting to change in a fast-paced environment and staying current with new technologies.

Compensation

CA$80,000–CA$95,000 base salary, commensurate with experience.

Litmus is committed to building an inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and will provide accommodation throughout the recruitment process upon request.

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

About the Role

Litmus is hiring a Senior GTM Stack Developer to own the technical layer of our revenue operations. You design, configure, automate, integrate, test, and maintain the systems that power our commercial process end-to-end. You'll work closely with our Director of RevOps and Manager of Revenue Operations to translate business requirements into working systems across our Salesforce-centric GTM stack.

This is an engineering role. You read a requirements doc, ask the right technical questions, and ship clean, tested solutions. You own the quality of what you build – not just the initial delivery.

You'll operate in a sprint-based environment with structured QA cycles, documented releases, and clear handoff standards. You work async with a Toronto-based team, so strong written and spoken English is required.

There is also room to grow into this role. Litmus is actively bringing AI-driven enrichment and agentic workflows into the GTM stack (Clay’s AI enrichment logic, Salesforce Agentforce/Einstein, HubSpot Breeze), and you’ll have a direct hand in deciding how those capabilities get designed into our commercial systems, not just maintaining what already exists.

What You'll Do

Salesforce platform

  • Configuration: objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, record types, permission sets, sharing rules

  • Automation: Flows, Apex triggers, Apex classes, batch jobs, scheduled jobs

  • Data model optimization and schema governance

  • Reports, dashboards, and KPI data layer

  • Sandbox management: org strategy, refresh cycles, deployment across dev/staging/production

  • Ongoing maintenance and enhancements: bug fixes, system updates, Salesforce release adaptation

Salesforce CPQ & quote-to-cash

  • Product catalog, pricebooks, bundles, subscription products, product rules

  • Pricing rules, discount schedules, approval matrices

  • Quote templates, output document design, e-signature integration

  • NetSuite ↔ SFDC handoff: own the integration and maintain clean data flow

Integrations & API work

  • SFDC ↔ HubSpot sync: contacts, leads, accounts, lifecycle stages, campaign attribution

  • Zendesk → SFDC: support ticket data into revenue pipeline and account health

  • NetSuite ↔ SFDC: evaluate, recommend, implement, and maintain the connector

  • REST and SOAP API integrations using middleware (Make, Workato, or equivalent)

Top-of-funnel & enrichment

  • Clay enrichment waterfalls: multi-vendor pipelines, fallback logic, field mapping into SFDC

  • Lead capture → enrichment → scoring → routing logic in SFDC and HubSpot

  • HubSpot workflow automation: lead nurture, lifecycle transitions, campaign operations

Testing, QA & deployment

  • Write and maintain Apex test classes meeting ≥85% code coverage on all custom code

  • Build and execute UAT test plans for all major releases before go-live

  • Manage sprint-based delivery cycles: story grooming, build, test, deploy, retrospective

  • Maintain a change log and release notes for every production deployment

What You'll Bring

Must Have

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Core

  • Strong experience with Salesforce CPQ

  • Apex Development (Classes, Triggers, Batch Apex, Scheduled Apex)

  • Lightning Web Components (LWC)

  • Flow Builder (Record-Triggered, Screen, Auto-Launched Flows)

  • SOQL & SOSL query writing

  • REST & SOAP API integrations

  • Experience with Salesforce integrations and middleware (Make, Workato, or equivalent)

  • Product catalog, bundles, pricing rules, and discount schedules in CPQ

  • Quote-to-Order process

  • Approval workflow configuration

  • Apex test class development and maintaining code coverage

  • Sandbox management and deployment using Change Sets/Metadata API

  • Experience integrating HubSpot with Salesforce

  • Experience integrating NetSuite (or similar ERP) with Salesforce

  • Experience with Zendesk (or equivalent support platform) integrations

  • Experience with output document templates

  • Working knowledge of BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent)

Required Certifications

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I

  • Salesforce CPQ Specialist

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.)

  • Understanding of AI-driven enrichment and agentic workflows

  • Experience with Clay enrichment pipelines

  • Familiarity with Salesforce Agentforce/Einstein

  • Familiarity with HubSpot Breeze

  • Ability to validate AI-generated enrichment, lead scoring, and content before production

  • Experience with Git-based source control

  • Exposure to Salesloft or Outreach

About the Role:

We are looking for a Senior Technical Writer who takes an AI-first approach to documentation. You will own end-to-end technical content for our industrial edge platform, working across multiple concurrent product releases, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and producing both written and video content that helps customers succeed with our product.

What You'll Do:

• Use AI tools as the default approach to drafting, structuring, reviewing, and maintaining documentation, rather than as an occasional aid.

• Own and manage technical documentation across multiple concurrent product releases, tracking version- specific changes and ensuring accuracy across all live versions.

• Plan, script, and produce video content (feature walkthroughs, release demos, how-to guides) in addition to written documentation.

• Get hands-on with the product directly, testing features and workflows first hand to validate documentation accuracy rather than relying solely on specs.

• Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, QA, and Support to gather release information, clarify feature behaviour, and align content timelines with release schedules.

• Translate complex technical and industrial concepts into clear, accessible content for varied audiences (OT engineers, plant managers, system integrators, enterprise architects).

• Maintain and enforce documentation style guides and standards for consistency across all content types.

• Build and maintain reusable content templates, review checklists, and AI-assisted content workflows to scale documentation output.

• Manage documentation release schedules independently, prioritizing across multiple in-flight projects.

Must Have

• 5+ years of technical writing experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, industrial, or enterprise software.

• Demonstrated experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) as a core part of a content workflow, not just for occasional edits.

• Experience creating video content: scripting, recording, and basic editing (tools such as Loom, Camtasia, or similar).

• Strong track record of working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Support teams.

• Comfortable getting hands-on with technical products; able to independently test and validate features.

• Excellent written English, with a clear, concise, technical-but-accessible style.

• Familiarity with documentation tooling (e.g., Markdown, static site generators, headless CMS, Git-based workflows).

• Must be based in Canada and legally eligible to work in Canada.

Nice to Have

• Experience in industrial automation, IIoT, or edge computing domains.

• Experience building or customizing AI-assisted documentation or review workflows.

• Familiarity with API documentation and developer-facing content

Job Title: Application Engineer - Litmus GCC, (Onboarding)

About the Role

The Application Engineer is a key technical role within the Litmus Customer Success team and is responsible for ensuring successful configuration, deployment, and value realization of Litmus Edge and Litmus Edge Manager for customers across the EMEA region.

The Application Engineer will work with prospective and existing customers during proof-of-concept projects and production implementations, validating requirements, developing best-practice configurations, and delivering technical outcomes that demonstrate measurable business value.

The Application Engineer will also partner closely with Sales Engineers, Account Managers, Product Management, Development, and the Litmus Support Desk to support pre-sales transitions, customer expansion, product feedback, and Level 2 technical support. This role reports to Manager Customer Success Operations with global reporting to the Director of Technical Delivery.

What You'll Do

• Validate customer requirements for proof of concept and production implementations of Litmus products

• Configure Litmus Edge and Litmus Edge Manager during proof of concepts, customer pilots, and production deployments

• Lead assigned technical implementation activities and ensure contracted technical responsibilities are delivered successfully

• Develop innovative solution approaches that help customers maximize value from Litmus products

• Maintain and contribute to internal solution libraries, deployment best practices, reusable configurations, and technical documentation

• Provide Level 2 technical support to the Litmus Service Desk, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and customer issue resolution

• Participate in on-call rotation for customers requiring 24x7 support coverage

• Support Sales Engineers and Account Managers with technical architecture reviews, proposal inputs, RFI/RFP responses, demonstrations, and smooth pre-sales to implementation handovers

• Provide field feedback to Product Management and Development on customer requirements, market gaps, bugs, and product enhancement opportunities

• Support webinars, customer meetings, partner enablement, value-added reseller discussions, and customer user group activities as required

What You'll Bring

Must Have

• Hands-on experience implementing software, infrastructure, automation, IIoT, analytics, or shop-floor solutions in a manufacturing environment

• Strong technical understanding of network protocols, system architecture, Linux-based systems, databases, and customer deployment environments

• Experience with product configuration, technical troubleshooting, and customer-facing implementation or support activities

• Working knowledge of scripting or coding using Python, JavaScript, or similar languages

• Understanding of containerized and cloud/hybrid infrastructure technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Azure, AWS, or GCP

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to work directly with customers, internal technical teams, sales teams, and partners

• Self-starter with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced, changing environment

Nice to Have

• Experience with Litmus Edge, Litmus Edge Manager, industrial data platforms, OPC/UA, PLC/SCADA systems, or edge connectivity use cases

• Exposure to pre-sales support, solution demonstrations, technical proposal review, RFI/RFP participation, or customer expansion activities

• Experience supporting partners, value-added resellers, webinars, customer focus groups, or user-group events

• Ability to translate field observations into clear product feedback, enhancement requests, and best-practice documentation

• Enjoys solving complex technical problems, learning new technologies, and helping customers realize measurable business value

Reports To: Manager Customer Success Operations

Job Title: Customer Success Application Engineer - Litmus GCC, EMEA

About the Role

The Application Engineer is a key technical role within the Litmus Customer Success team and is responsible for ensuring successful configuration, deployment, and value realization of Litmus Edge and Litmus Edge Manager for customers across the EMEA region.

The Application Engineer will work with prospective and existing customers during proof-of-concept projects and production implementations, validating requirements, developing best-practice configurations, and delivering technical outcomes that demonstrate measurable business value.

The Application Engineer will also partner closely with Sales Engineers, Account Managers, Product Management, Development, and the Litmus Support Desk to support pre-sales transitions, customer expansion, product feedback, and Level 2 technical support. This role reports to Manager Customer Success Operations with global reporting to the Director of Technical Delivery.

What You'll Do

• Validate customer requirements for proof of concept and production implementations of Litmus products

• Configure Litmus Edge and Litmus Edge Manager during proof of concepts, customer pilots, and production deployments

• Lead assigned technical implementation activities and ensure contracted technical responsibilities are delivered successfully

• Develop innovative solution approaches that help customers maximize value from Litmus products

• Maintain and contribute to internal solution libraries, deployment best practices, reusable configurations, and technical documentation

• Provide Level 2 technical support to the Litmus Service Desk, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and customer issue resolution

• Participate in on-call rotation for customers requiring 24x7 support coverage

• Support Sales Engineers and Account Managers with technical architecture reviews, proposal inputs, RFI/RFP responses, demonstrations, and smooth pre-sales to implementation handovers

• Provide field feedback to Product Management and Development on customer requirements, market gaps, bugs, and product enhancement opportunities

• Support webinars, customer meetings, partner enablement, value-added reseller discussions, and customer user group activities as required

What You'll Bring

Must Have

• Hands-on experience implementing software, infrastructure, automation, IIoT, analytics, or shop-floor solutions in a manufacturing environment

• Strong technical understanding of network protocols, system architecture, Linux-based systems, databases, and customer deployment environments

• Experience with product configuration, technical troubleshooting, and customer-facing implementation or support activities

• Working knowledge of scripting or coding using Python, JavaScript, or similar languages

• Understanding of containerized and cloud/hybrid infrastructure technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Azure, AWS, or GCP

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to work directly with customers, internal technical teams, sales teams, and partners

• Self-starter with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced, changing environment

Nice to Have

• Experience with Litmus Edge, Litmus Edge Manager, industrial data platforms, OPC/UA, PLC/SCADA systems, or edge connectivity use cases

• Exposure to pre-sales support, solution demonstrations, technical proposal review, RFI/RFP participation, or customer expansion activities

• Experience supporting partners, value-added resellers, webinars, customer focus groups, or user-group events

• Ability to translate field observations into clear product feedback, enhancement requests, and best-practice documentation

• Enjoys solving complex technical problems, learning new technologies, and helping customers realize measurable business value

Reports To: Manager Customer Success Operations

About the Role

The Customer Success Partner Enablement Manager is a key role within the Litmus Customer Success team intended to support and strengthen relationships with our partner network. This role is responsible for ensuring Litmus partners are equipped to successfully deploy, support, and promote Litmus software using established Litmus best practices and processes.

The Partner Success Manager will serve as a trusted advisor to partners, helping them understand Litmus product capabilities, adopt new features, follow deployment standards, and deliver a high-quality customer experience. This is a highly collaborative, partner-facing role that requires strong technical knowledge, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work directly with partner teams both remotely and on-site. The Customer Success Partner Manager will continue to build the relationship with the partner, ensuring a consistent stream of knowledge transfer and collaboration remain in place.

Travel to partner locations will be required.

The Partner Success Manager reports directly to the Vice President of Customer Success and will work together with other Customer Success team members, Litmus Account Sales Executives, Litmus Partner team, and Litmus Support teams to ensure success.

What You’ll Do

· Serve as the primary engagement contact for assigned Litmus partners.

· Onboarding and training of new Litmus partners

· Build strong, trusted relationships with partner stakeholders, including technical, implementation, and leadership teams.

· Educate partners on Litmus best practices for deployment, configuration, implementation, and ongoing support.

· Provide technical guidance to partners during onboarding, implementation planning, and customer deployments.

· Showcase new Litmus features, product enhancements, and platform capabilities to partner teams.

· Collaborate with internal teams, including Partner, Sales, Customer Success, Product, Support, and Engineering, to resolve partner questions and drive successful outcomes.

· Identify gaps in partner knowledge, process adherence, or technical readiness and develop plans to address them.

· Monitor partner engagement, deployment quality, and overall partner satisfaction.

· Gather partner feedback and share insights with internal teams to improve processes, documentation, and product adoption.

· Manage escalations related to partner-led deployments or technical implementation challenges.

· Travel to partner sites as needed to conduct training, business reviews, technical workshops, and relationship-building meetings.

What You’ll Bring

Must Have

· Minimum 5 to 10 years experience in training and enablement, partner management, customer success, implementation, solutions consulting, technical account management, or a similar customer-facing technical enablement role

· Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand, explain, and guide software deployment processes.

· Experience working with enterprise software, SaaS platforms, industrial software, IoT platforms, data and cloud platforms, or related technologies.

· Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

· Experience training customers, partners, or internal teams on software products and processes.

· Ability to manage multiple partner relationships, priorities, and projects simultaneously.

Nice to Have

· Technical curiosity and ability to quickly learn new products and features.

· Experience with Wrike

· Enjoys staying abreast of new technology and continually learning new thingsTop of Form

· Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate complex deployment or process-related challenges.

· Comfortable working cross-functionally with partner, sales, product, support, and engineering teams.

Reports To: Vice President of Customer Success

raw.descriptionHtml:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

About the Role

The Customer Success Partner Enablement Manager is a key role within the Litmus Customer Success team intended to support and strengthen relationships with our partner network. This role is responsible for ensuring Litmus partners are equipped to successfully deploy, support, and promote Litmus software using established Litmus best practices and processes.

The Partner Success Manager will serve as a trusted advisor to partners, helping them understand Litmus product capabilities, adopt new features, follow deployment standards, and deliver a high-quality customer experience. This is a highly collaborative, partner-facing role that requires strong technical knowledge, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work directly with partner teams both remotely and on-site. The Customer Success Partner Manager will continue to build the relationship with the partner, ensuring a consistent stream of knowledge transfer and collaboration remain in place.

Travel to partner locations will be required.

The Partner Success Manager reports directly to the Vice President of Customer Success and will work together with other Customer Success team members, Litmus Account Sales Executives, Litmus Partner team, and Litmus Support teams to ensure success.

What You’ll Do

· Serve as the primary engagement contact for assigned Litmus partners.

· Onboarding and training of new Litmus partners

· Build strong, trusted relationships with partner stakeholders, including technical, implementation, and leadership teams.

· Educate partners on Litmus best practices for deployment, configuration, implementation, and ongoing support.

· Provide technical guidance to partners during onboarding, implementation planning, and customer deployments.

· Showcase new Litmus features, product enhancements, and platform capabilities to partner teams.

· Collaborate with internal teams, including Partner, Sales, Customer Success, Product, Support, and Engineering, to resolve partner questions and drive successful outcomes.

· Identify gaps in partner knowledge, process adherence, or technical readiness and develop plans to address them.

· Monitor partner engagement, deployment quality, and overall partner satisfaction.

· Gather partner feedback and share insights with internal teams to improve processes, documentation, and product adoption.

· Manage escalations related to partner-led deployments or technical implementation challenges.

· Travel to partner sites as needed to conduct training, business reviews, technical workshops, and relationship-building meetings.

What You’ll Bring

Must Have

· Minimum 5 to 10 years experience in training and enablement, partner management, customer success, implementation, solutions consulting, technical account management, or a similar customer-facing technical enablement role

· Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand, explain, and guide software deployment processes.

· Experience working with enterprise software, SaaS platforms, industrial software, IoT platforms, data and cloud platforms, or related technologies.

· Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

· Experience training customers, partners, or internal teams on software products and processes.

· Ability to manage multiple partner relationships, priorities, and projects simultaneously.

Nice to Have

· Technical curiosity and ability to quickly learn new products and features.

· Experience with Wrike

· Enjoys staying abreast of new technology and continually learning new thingsTop of Form

· Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate complex deployment or process-related challenges.

· Comfortable working cross-functionally with partner, sales, product, support, and engineering teams.

Reports To: Vice President of Customer Success

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.




WHY JOIN LITMUS





BUILD THE INFRASTRUCTURE THAT MAKES INDUSTRIAL AI POSSIBLE

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.





WORK ON PROBLEMS WHERE SOFTWARE MEETS THE REAL WORLD

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.





HAVE REAL IMPACT, FAST

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.





JOIN A HIGH-PERFORMANCE TEAM

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.




OUR CULTURE

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

The Principal Application Engineer is the senior technical authority within the Litmus Customer Success team for the APAC region. This role provides technical leadership, oversight, and direction to the regional Application Engineering team, ensuring that customer implementations of Litmus Edge and Litmus Edge Manager are architecturally sound, delivered consistently, and aligned with customer outcomes and Litmus best practices.

The Principal Application Engineer will oversee the technical work of Application Engineers supporting proof-of-concept projects, pilots, production implementations, customer expansions, and complex support engagements. This person will establish regional technical priorities, review and approve solution designs, guide application engineers through complex technical decisions, and ensure that contracted technical responsibilities are delivered successfully.

As a senior individual contributor and regional technical leader, the Principal Application Engineer will act as the escalation point for high-risk implementations, critical customer issues, and complex architectural decisions. The role will also mentor Application Engineers, improve delivery standards, and develop reusable technical approaches that increase the quality, predictability, and scalability of customer delivery across APAC.

The Principal Application Engineer will partner closely with Customer Success leadership, Sales Engineers, Account Managers, Product Management, Development, partners, and the Litmus Support Desk.  - Serve as the senior technical authority for Customer Success application engineering activities across the APAC region and provide technical direction, guidance, standards adherence and oversight to Application Engineers.

 - Establish technical priorities for the regional Application Engineering team in alignment with customer commitments, commercial objectives, available capacity, implementation risk, and business value.

 - Work with Customer Success leadership to assign technical resources and determine the appropriate level of engineering support for customer engagements.

 - Balance immediate customer requirements with long-term maintainability, product strategy, delivery scalability, and Litmus technical standards.

 - Ensure that technical solutions demonstrate measurable business value and support customers’ operational, manufacturing, data, automation, and digital transformation objectives.

 - Identify implementation dependencies, assumptions, risks, and technical gaps early in the customer lifecycle.

 - Support Application Engineers during customer meetings when senior technical leadership, architecture expertise, or escalation management is required.

 - Maintain consistency in how Litmus products are designed, configured, deployed, tested, and supported across the APAC region.

 - Define when technical exceptions may be approved and document the risks, conditions, and mitigation requirements associated with those exceptions.

 - Onboard, mentor and coach Application Engineers, helping them strengthen their architecture, implementation, troubleshooting, customer communication, and decision-making capabilities.

 - Significant experience leading complex software, infrastructure, automation, IIoT, analytics, edge-computing, or shop-floor implementations in manufacturing or industrial environments.

 - Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership, architecture oversight, design approval, and implementation governance across multiple simultaneous customer engagements.

 - Experience directing or overseeing the work of engineers, including setting technical priorities, reviewing deliverables, mentoring team members, and making technical decisions.

 - Strong understanding of industrial and enterprise solution architecture, including networks, security, protocols, Linux-based systems, databases, APIs, data pipelines, and distributed deployment environments.

 - Deep hands-on experience with product configuration, systems integration, technical troubleshooting, performance analysis, root-cause analysis, and production support.

 - Strong customer-facing skills, including the ability to lead architecture workshops, explain complex technical concepts, manage technical objections, and communicate risk clearly.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence customers, engineers, sales teams, partners, product leaders, and executives.

 - Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance customer urgency, contractual commitments, technical risk, team capacity, and strategic value.

 - Ability to operate independently as a senior technical leader while collaborating effectively across regional and global teams.

 - Willingness and ability to support customers and engineers across APAC time zones and to travel regionally when required.

Nice to Have

 - Experience with Litmus Edge, Litmus Edge Manager, industrial data platforms, edge orchestration platforms, or similar technologies.

 - Strong knowledge of industrial protocols and systems, including OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus, PLCs, SCADA, historians, MES, and industrial control environments.

 - Experience designing highly available, secure, and scalable industrial edge architectures across multiple facilities or geographic regions.

 - Knowledge of cybersecurity practices for operational technology, industrial networks, edge devices, and hybrid cloud environments.

 - Experience supporting regulated, mission-critical, or high-availability customer environments.

 - Experience with pre-sales architecture, technical discovery, proposal approval, statement-of-work review, RFI/RFP responses, and commercial scope validation.

 - Experience working with systems integrators, channel partners, value-added resellers, and regional technology partners.

 - Experience contributing to product roadmaps, design reviews, beta programs, technical validation, or release-readiness processes.

 - Experience developing technical standards, reference architectures, implementation methodologies, and reusable engineering assets.

 - Relevant certifications in cloud architecture, Kubernetes, networking, cybersecurity, industrial automation, or solution architecture.

 - Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, automation, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Measures of Success

 - Quality, consistency, and scalability of APAC customer implementations.

 - Successful delivery of strategic proof-of-concept and production engagements.

 - Reduction in implementation risk, technical rework, escalations, and recurring support issues.

 - Timeliness and quality of regional technical decisions and approvals.

 - Customer adoption, value realization, satisfaction, and expansion.

 - Development and technical readiness of Application Engineers.

 - Adoption of regional and global delivery standards, reusable assets, and best practices.

 - Effectiveness of pre-sales-to-delivery handovers and technical scope validation.

 - Quality and influence of APAC field feedback provided to Product Management and Development.

 - Ability to balance customer priorities, team capacity, delivery commitments, and long-term technical quality.

Reports To: Manager, Customer Success Operations
