Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

About the Role

The Application Engineer is a key technical role within the Litmus Customer Success team and is responsible for ensuring successful configuration, deployment, and value realization of Litmus Edge and Litmus Edge Manager for customers across the North and South America region.

The Application Engineer will work with prospective and existing customers during proof-of-concept projects and production implementations, validating requirements, developing best-practice configurations, and delivering technical outcomes that demonstrate measurable business value.

The Application Engineer will also partner closely with Sales Engineers, Account Managers, Product Management, Development, and the Litmus Support Desk to support pre-sales transitions, customer expansion, product feedback, and Level 2 technical support. This role reports to the Director of Technical Delivery.

What You'll Do

• Validate customer requirements for proof of concept and production implementations of Litmus products

• Configure Litmus products during proof of concepts, customer pilots, and production deployments

• Lead assigned technical implementation activities and ensure contracted technical responsibilities are delivered successfully

• Develop innovative solution approaches that help customers maximize value from Litmus products

• Maintain and contribute to internal solution libraries, deployment best practices, reusable configurations, and technical documentation

• Provide Level 2 technical support to the Litmus Service Desk, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and customer issue resolution

• Participate in on-call rotation for customers requiring 24x7 support coverage

• Support Sales Engineers and Account Managers with technical architecture reviews, proposal inputs, RFI/RFP responses, demonstrations, and smooth pre-sales to implementation handovers

• Provide field feedback to Product Management and Development on customer requirements, market gaps, bugs, and product enhancement opportunities

• Support webinars, customer meetings, partner enablement, value-added reseller discussions, and customer user group activities as required

What You'll Bring

Must Have

• Hands-on experience implementing software, infrastructure, automation, IIoT, analytics, or shop-floor solutions in a manufacturing environment

• Strong technical understanding of network protocols, system architecture, Linux-based systems, databases, and customer deployment environments

• Experience with product configuration, technical troubleshooting, and customer-facing implementation or support activities

• Working knowledge of scripting or coding using Python, JavaScript, or similar languages

• Understanding of containerized and cloud/hybrid infrastructure technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Azure, AWS, or GCP

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to work directly with customers, internal technical teams, sales teams, and partners

• Self-starter with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced, changing environment

Nice to Have

• Experience with Litmus products, industrial data platforms, OPC/UA, PLC/SCADA systems, or edge connectivity use cases

• Exposure to pre-sales support, solution demonstrations, technical proposal review, RFI/RFP participation, or customer expansion activities

• Experience supporting partners, value-added resellers, webinars, customer focus groups, or user-group events

• Ability to translate field observations into clear product feedback, enhancement requests, and best-practice documentation

• Enjoys solving complex technical problems, learning new technologies, and helping customers realize measurable business value

Reports To: Director of Technical Delivery

• Working knowledge of scripting or coding using Python, JavaScript, or similar languages

High visibility, significant autonomy, and direct impact on both revenue and our position within the partner ecosystems. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Opportunity Development & Complex Sales Execution. Working with marketing, partner operations, and our partners, identify and develop large strategic opportunities (typically $500k+ TCV or multi-year strategic deals) where partner involvement is material to winning. - Build compelling business cases that articulate ROI through combined capabilities (e.g., real-time edge analytics feeding Databricks Lakehouse for advanced AI, AWS edge/IoT scale with Timestream/InfluxDB integration, Microsoft Azure IoT Edge + Fabric governance and Power BI operational visibility). - Seamlessly transition initial discovery and qualification to the Litmus enterprise AE for value quantification, multi-threaded stakeholder management, commercial structuring, and final negotiation. - Strategic Partner Orchestration & Co-Sell Activation. Serve as the primary point of contact with partner account teams, industry advisors, alliance managers, and field sellers at our CAI partners. Activate and optimize co-sell motions, deal registration, and opportunity handoff. - GTM development. Collaborate with partners and internal Litmus teams to create campaigns and repeatable playbooks for outreach and CAI partner development. Develop and deliver joint presentations, workshops, and lunch and learns that engage partner sellers and demonstrate the value for our combined solutions. Contribute to joint marketing initiatives (webinars, case studies, events) and sales enablement content that helps our broader team sell with and through these partners. - Lead and Opportunity Management. Track and report partner-sourced, partner-influenced, and co-sell revenue; optimize for both direct and influenced attribution. Provide market and competitive intelligence back to product, marketing, and leadership to shape our partner strategy and roadmap influence. - Internal Leadership & Enablement. Enable and coach field sales teams on partner value propositions, selling motions, and when/how to engage you and the partner teams. Represent the company at key partner events (e.g., re:Invent, Microsoft Ignite, Databricks Summit, Hannover Messe, etc.) and customer executive briefings. - Key Metrics: Pipeline, ARR, partner satisfaction WHAT YOU’LL BRING - 7+ years of enterprise software/SaaS sales, strategic business development, or complex deal orchestration experience - Proven experience working with or selling alongside at least two of the following: Microsoft (Azure, IoT, Fabric, Power Platform, or Co-Sell), AWS (edge, IoT, analytics services), or Databricks (Lakehouse, partnerships, or co-sell). - Strong understanding of Industrial AI, edge computing, and data platforms; familiarity with Litmus's technology stack is a plus. - Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence at executive levels. - Experience driving revenue through ecosystems, including joint sales and marketing initiatives. - Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; MBA preferred. - Ability to travel up to 20% for partner meetings and events. - Self-starter with a strategic mindset, capable of thriving in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

As we continue to grow our global footprint, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced Sales Leader in North America to lead our regional commercial strategy, build a high-performing team, and accelerate adoption of the Litmus platform across the United States and Canada.

Position Overview

The Sales Director is a leadership role responsible for driving revenue growth, leading the regional sales organization, and expanding Litmus’ enterprise customer base across industrial markets in Japan and Asia (outside of India). You will own pipeline development, forecast accuracy, territory planning, and team performance while partnering closely with cross-functional GTM leaders.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing industrial technology company and drive transformational impact for some of the world’s largest manufacturers.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Building

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing enterprise sales team across Japan and Asia.

  • Hire, onboard, coach, and mentor Account Executives, SEs, BDRs and regional leaders.

  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and excellence.

  • Implement consistent processes, sales cadences, and performance standards.

Sales Strategy & Execution

  • Define and execute the regional go-to-market strategy aligned with corporate goals.

  • Drive predictable revenue generation through world-class sales processes and methodologies (including MEDDIC).

  • Develop regional growth plans, territory segmentation, and account prioritization.

  • Lead from the front by engaging directly with strategic enterprise accounts and executive stakeholders.

Pipeline Development & Forecasting

  • Own pipeline creation, qualification, and progression across Japan and Asia.

  • Ensure rigorous adherence to the MEDDIC methodology for deal execution.

  • Deliver accurate monthly and quarterly revenue forecasts.

  • Identify gaps early and implement corrective actions to maintain target attainment.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Partnerships to support regional growth.

  • Provide market insights to Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities.

  • Collaborate with the Partner ecosystem (GSIs, OEMs, technology partners) to scale market reach.

  • Work with Operations and Finance on pricing, contracts, forecasting, and deal structuring.

Customer & Partner Engagement

  • Act as an executive sponsor for key enterprise manufacturing customers.

  • Support major customer meetings, executive briefings, and value assessments.

  • Build strong relationships with regional partners, distributors, and system integrators.

  • Represent Litmus at industry conferences, events, and thought leadership forums.

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain a disciplined sales operating rhythm, including QBRs, pipeline reviews, and weekly deal inspection.

  • Optimize sales processes, tools (CRM), KPIs, and workflows for efficiency and scale.

  • Ensure compliance with all corporate policies, pricing guidelines, and commercial governance.

Travel

  • Travel within Japan and Asia region frequently to meet customers and partners (up to 25–40%).

  • Occasional travel internationally, including to EMEA and APAC, for leadership meetings and company events.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • 10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with at least 5 years in sales leadership roles covering Japan and Asia.

  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding multi-million dollar revenue targets for new business acquisition.

  • Experience selling complex software solutions into manufacturing or industrial, markets.

  • Familiarity with the MEDDIC or MEDDPICC sales methodology and ability to coach teams in its use.

  • Demonstrated success building and scaling high-performance enterprise sales teams.

  • Strong experience managing long, complex sales cycles with C-level buyers.

  • Expertise in pipeline development, forecasting, and enterprise deal management.

  • Excellent communication, executive presence, and negotiation skills.

  • Bilingual language communication skills (Japanese and English mandatory)

  • Ability to operate in high-growth, fast-changing technology environments.

Preferred

  • Background in industrial technology, IoT/IIoT, data platforms, analytics, or OT/IT integration.

  • Experience with manufacturing digital transformation programs or industrial automation ecosystems.

  • Success working with GSIs, technology alliances, and channel partners.

Why Join Litmus?

  • Influence the strategy and growth of a rapidly scaling global organization.

  • Partner with some of the world’s most innovative manufacturers.

  • Work at the forefront of industrial digital transformation

  • Competitive compensation package including salary, performance bonus, and equity.

Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

About the Role

Litmus Automation is hiring a Site Reliability Engineer to own the day-to-day reliability, security, and performance of our Azure-hosted Litmus Unified Namespace (UNS) and Litmus Edge Manager (LEM) environment, deployed for a strategic enterprise customer. This role covers the full lifecycle: initial environment provisioning and hardening, deployment support, ongoing monitoring and incident response, and long-term operation against a 99.9% uptime commitment. You will work directly with customer-facing infrastructure spanning AKS, Azure networking, managed databases, identity federation, and MQTT-based data pipelines connecting multiple sites. As this is an SRE role held to a 99.9% uptime commitment, it includes participation in an on-call rotation to ensure continuous coverage and rapid incident response outside of standard working hours.

Key Responsibilities

• Provision, configure, and maintain cloud infrastructure spanning compute, container orchestration, networking, and database services.

• Own end-to-end monitoring and alerting, and build/maintain operational dashboards that give clear visibility into system health and performance.

• Drive response and on-call support to meet uptime SLAs, including root cause analysis and post-incident reviews.

• Implement and maintain a strong security baseline, including vulnerability management, secrets management, network security controls, and certificate lifecycle management.

• Configure and support identity/SSO integration between internal and customer identity providers, troubleshooting authentication issues as needed.

• Manage networking and connectivity to support reliable, high-throughput data flows across distributed environments and sites.

• Monitor and report on infrastructure usage and consumption against agreed baselines; support capacity planning.

• Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines to automate provisioning and deployment.

• Manage backup and disaster recovery processes and periodically validate recovery procedures.

• Participate in customer-facing environment validation, UAT support, and go-live sign-off activities.

• Maintain clear runbooks, documentation, and knowledge transfer materials for the environment.

Required Qualifications

• 4-8 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Cloud Infrastructure roles, with significant hands-on Azure experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with core Azure services: AKS, Virtual Machines, VNet/NSG/Load Balancer/Application Gateway, Azure Database for PostgreSQL/MySQL, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics.

• Practical experience administering and troubleshooting Kubernetes’ workloads in production.

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.

• Proficiency in scripting/automation using Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

• Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, TLS/SSL, load balancing, firewalls/NSGs).

• Experience with incident management, on-call rotations, and SLA-driven operations.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to work directly with customer stakeholders during validation and escalations.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

◦ Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (Azure DevOps certification) is required.

◦ Experience with identity federation and SSO protocols (OIDC/SAML), particularly Key cloak and/or Okta.

◦ Familiarity with MQTT or other IoT/industrial data protocols.

◦ Additional certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).

◦ Experience supporting manufacturing, industrial, or IoT customer environments.

end lifecycle of Litmus's presence across cloud, AI, and data marketplaces including AWS,

In addition to cloud marketplace ownership, you will drive strategic OEM partnerships

where Litmus technology white-labeled within partner solutions. Working closely with

partners such as Belden, SLB, Emerson, Google, and future OEMs, you will help define

technical feasibility and business value.

and release readiness across cloud and OEM ecosystems.

• Monitor marketplace performance, customer adoption, competitive trends, and partner

engagement to identify new growth opportunities and optimize product investments.

incorporating customer, partner, and market insights into future offerings and strategic

initiatives.

• 8+ years of product management experience in enterprise software, cloud platforms,

architectures, and system integrations.

• Experience creating PRDs, EPICs, user stories, and leading Agile product execution.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving

skills.

• Experience with Azure Marketplace, AWS Marketplace, Google Cloud Marketplace,

• Experience with cloud partner programs such as AWS ISV Accelerate, Azure

Marketplace and Co-sell, or Google Cloud Partner Advantage.

• Familiarity with generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and modern AI platforms.

raw.descriptionHtml:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

About The Role:

We're looking for a QA Architect to own test automation and quality for Litmus Edge Manager (LEM), our platform for managing distributed edge deployments at scale. In this role, you'll build out a modern Playwright automation framework for LEM, define what "release-ready" means through clear quality gates, and act as the bridge between our engineering leadership and our growing international QA team. You'll set the standards and priorities that guide their day-to-day testing work. This is a hands-on, high-visibility role for someone who wants to shape how quality is built into a fast-moving product.

What You Will Do:

  • Design and build a Playwright automation framework for Litmus Edge Manager (LEM)

  • Serve as the QA coordination point between leadership and the India-based testing team for LEM — setting test scope, priority, and quality standards

  • Build and maintain LEM test cases in Xray, tracking automation coverage per release

  • Use and champion AI-assisted test generation tooling to produce Playwright scripts and test cases from tickets, design files, and specs

  • Coordinate LEM–LE integration testing with related product teams as needed

What You Will Bring:

Must Have:

  • Hands-on experience designing and building automated test frameworks using Playwright or a similar modern automation framework (UI and API/E2E)

  • Comfortable working in a Linux environment

  • Strong JavaScript or Java skills

  • Experience with BDD methodologies and practices

  • Experience coordinating with distributed QA teams

  • Familiarity with test management tools (e.g., Xray/Jira) and CI/CD-integrated automation

  • Experience defining test strategy, quality standards, automation coverage, or release-readiness criteria

Nice To Have:

  • Experience with AI-assisted test generation or AI-powered QA tooling

  • Cypress experience; industrial edge/IoT product testing background

  • Hands-on Docker experience
